answer: The ember test I would run is Ordained farm manager registration with farmers union attestation: a registration the union renews after farm audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration the union renews after farm audits stays private; the ocean is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the echo of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
